m: पज् or पञ्ज्, to become stiff or rigid, only pf. Ā. पापजे with अप, he started back from (loc.), RV. x, 105, 3. [cf. Gk. πήγνυμι; Lat. pango.]

पज्रा (आ), f. the Soma plant, ib.

m: पज्र mf(आ)n. solid, stout, fat, strong, RV. [cf. Gk. πηγός]
accord. to some also = ‘shining, bright’ [cf. पाजस्, p. 614]; also ‘clear, loud’, said of a voice
पज्र m. N. of Kakṣīvat and other men, ib.
पज्र n. N. of a Sāman, Lāṭy.
a: पज्र — a. Ved. 1 Powerful, strong. --2 Wealthy, rich. --ज्रः An epithet of Aṅgiras.

m: पज्र—होषिन् mfn. having fat or rich oblations (Indra-Agni), RV. vi, 59, 4 (cf. Nir. v, 22).
पज्रिय m. N. of Kakṣīvat, RV.
